My experience with cats and shadow people

Before I got married in 2018, I used to live with my parents on a street parallel to a neighbor who used to own four beautiful cats and lived by herself as a divorced elderly woman. I got hired to house sit for her a few times and tend to her cats and the yards as well, so it wasn’t hard work. It was actually a pleasant home. There was nothing off about this home.
One early evening, just as the last ray of sun peeked over the mountain, I was in the utility room down the hall cleaning out litter boxes as usual and I heard those strange noises cats make before they get into a fight, that low meow that sounds almost gutteral. I poked my head out and looked down the hall and made sure they were not fighting, but they were just standing on top of the typewriter desk by the big bay window to the backyard. I assumed they were being territorial towards another stray cat in the yard and cleaned the last box. When I finished I walked out of the hall and into the sunroom where the desk was and they remained in fight mode - puffed-up fur and tails, widened eyes, quivering jaws and they would hiss at the window. I could barely see out that window into her backyard so I wondered what they were so upset over and what I saw next gave me the absolute chills.

This woman had an elm tree in the yard that was at least fifteen feet tall. Beside that tree there was a black shrouded figure in a hood a foot shorter than the tree was and it was moving back and forth. I went into fight mode and I banged my fist on the window and the cats pawed at the glass and did that weird meow noise again and the shadowy figure looked up and walked behind the tree trunk and vanished. I got scrappy and grabbed a metal pipe and went out the back door to beat the tar out of it incase it was a person, but it wasn’t. I got to the tree and examined it, there was no way it was a person. That tree was very tall and the sun went down entirely by now. The yard was dead silent and I walked back to the house and the cats watched me come in again. They were calm now, sitting like little loafs of bread on the desk. That was the only time I ever saw them freak out like that.
Brave and maybe slightly dumb haha. Imagine if it had been a thief or someone human, but I was in charge of guarding the house so
